15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (-35): reported board scrutiny; price is BELOW TREND (1W: -8.80% | 1M: -19.02%), confirming weakness. INTC (-35): headline flagged risks around government investment; price is BELOW TREND (1W: -14.42% | 1M: -47.44%), confirming weakness; TSLA (-35) is BELOW TREND (1W: -10.40% | 1M: -4.47%), while TTWO (-40) is ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +2.63%), diverging from its negative headline.
